        double tn = torque.norm();\n            double need = std::max(0.004, (thresh - worst_d) + 0.003);\n            double step_p = std::min(0.018, need);\n            if (fn > 1e-6) pose.p = pose.p + force * (step_p / fn);\n            if (tn > 1e-6) {\n                double step_r = std::min(0.030, need * 1.3);\n                Quat dq = quat_from_rotvec(torque * (step_r / tn));\n                pose.q = (dq * pose.q).normalized();\n            }\n        }\n        return is_valid(pose, thresh, stride);\n    }\n\n    bool valid_edge_fast(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, double thresh) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int n_steps = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.015), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.030)});\n        // Bisection order catches mid-edge collisions in 1 check!\n        if (!is_valid(pose_interp(a, b, 0.5), thresh, 8)) return false;\n        for (int i = 1; i <= n_steps; ++i) {\n            if (i * 2 == n_steps) continue;\n            if (!is_valid(pose_interp(a, b, (double)i / n_steps), thresh, 8)) return false;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Exact full-resolution (91,875 leaves, 4mm step, both sync & unsync curves!)\n    bool valid_edge_exact(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, double thresh) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int n_steps = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.006), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.012)});\n        for (int i = 1; i <= n_steps; ++i) {\n            double u = (double)i / n_steps;\n            if (!is_valid(pose_interp(a, b, u), thresh, 1)) return false;\n        }\n        double t_lin = dp / 0.1, t_ang = dq / 0.1, t_max = std::max(t_lin, t_ang);\n        if (t_max > 1e-6 && std::abs(t_lin - t_ang) > 0.015) {\n            for (int i = 1; i < n_steps; ++i) {\n                double t = t_max * ((double)i / n_steps);\n                double ul = (t_lin > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_lin) : 1.0;\n                double ua = (t_ang > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_ang) : 1.0;\n                Pose pu = {a.p + (b.p - a.p) * ul, quat_slerp(a.q, b.q, ua)};\n                if (!is_valid(pu, thresh, 1)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double edge_min_clearance(const Pose& a, const Pose& b) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int n_steps = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.005), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.010)});\n        double worst = 1.0;\n        double t_lin = dp / 0.1, t_ang = dq / 0.1, t_max = std::max(t_lin, t_ang);\n        for (int i = 0; i <= n_steps; ++i) {\n            double u = (double)i / n_steps;\n            worst = std::min(worst, min_clearance(pose_interp(a, b, u), worst));\n            if (t_max > 1e-6 && std::abs(t_lin - t_ang) > 0.01) {\n                double t = t_max * u;\n                double ul = (t_lin > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_lin) : 1.0;\n                double ua = (t_ang > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_ang) : 1.0;\n                Pose pu = {a.p + (b.p - a.p) * ul, quat_slerp(a.q, b.q, ua)};\n                worst = std::min(worst, min_clearance(pu, worst));\n            }\n        }\n        return worst;\n    }\n\n    bool check_infinity_escape(const Pose& pose, double escape_thresh, Vec3* best_dir_out = nullptr, double* best_clr_out = nullptr) const {\n        const int N_DIRS = 300;\n        const double golden = 3.14159265358979323846 * (3.0 - std::sqrt(5.0));\n        double best_ray_clr = -1.0;\n        Vec3 best_dir = {0, 0, 1};\n\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        Vec3 bmin = {1e9, 1e9, 1e9}, bmax = {-1e9, -1e9, -1e9};\n        for (const auto& ts : top) {\n            Vec3 w = R.apply(ts.cx, ts.cy, ts.cz) + pose.p;\n            bmin.x = std::min(bmin.x, w.x - ts.r); bmax.x = std::max(bmax.x, w.x + ts.r);\n            bmin.y = std::min(bmin.y, w.y - ts.r); bmax.y = std::max(bmax.y, w.y + ts.r);\n            bmin.z = std::min(bmin.z, w.z - ts.r); bmax.z = std::max(bmax.z, w.z + ts.r);\n        }\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < N_DIRS; ++i) {\n            double y = 1.0 - (2.0 * i + 1.0) / N_DIRS;\n            double rad = std::sqrt(std::max(0.0, 1.0 - y * y));\n            double phi = golden * i;\n            Vec3 dir = {std::cos(phi) * rad, y, std::sin(phi) * rad};\n\n            double ray_min = 1.0;\n            bool ok = true;\n            for (double s = 0.0; s <= 4.5; s += 0.025) {\n                Vec3 shift = dir * s;\n                if ((bmin.x + shift.x > a_max.x + 0.25 && dir.x >= 0) ||\n                    (bmax.x + shift.x < a_min.x - 0.25 && dir.x <= 0) ||\n                    (bmin.y + shift.y > a_max.y + 0.25 && dir.y >= 0) ||\n                    (bmax.y + shift.y < a_min.y - 0.25 && dir.y <= 0) ||\n                    (bmin.z + shift.z > a_max.z + 0.25 && dir.z >= 0) ||\n                    (bmax.z + shift.z < a_min.z - 0.25 && dir.z <= 0)) {\n                    break;\n                }\n                Vec3 sp = pose.p + shift;\n                double c = 1.0;\n                double cut = std::max(escape_thresh, best_ray_clr);\n                for (const auto& ts : top) {\n                    Vec3 wt = R.apply(ts.cx, ts.cy, ts.cz) + sp;\n                    double dt = eval_sdf(wt.x, wt.y, wt.z);\n                    if (dt - ts.r >= cut) continue;\n                    int m_end = ts.start + ts.count;\n                    for (int mi = ts.start; mi < m_end; ++mi) {\n                        const auto& ms = mid[mi];\n                        Vec3 wm = R.apply(ms.cx, ms.cy, ms.cz) + sp;\n                        double dm = eval_sdf(wm.x, wm.y, wm.z);\n                        if (dm - ms.r >= cut) continue;\n                        if (dm < escape_thresh) { ok = false; break; }\n                        int l_end = ms.start + ms.count;\n                        for (int li = ms.start; li < l_end; li += 2) {\n                            const auto& lf = leaves[li];\n                            Vec3 wl = R.apply(lf.x, lf.y, lf.z) + sp;\n                            double dl = eval_sdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                            if (dl < escape_thresh) { ok = false; break; }\n                            if (dl < c) c = dl;\n                        }\n                        if (!ok) break;\n                    }\n                    if (!ok) break;\n                }\n                if (!ok) break;\n                if (c < ray_min) ray_min = c;\n            }\n            if (ok && ray_min > best_ray_clr) {\n                best_ray_clr = ray_min;\n                best_dir = dir;\n            }\n        }\n        if (best_dir_out) *best_dir_out = best_dir;\n        if (best_clr_out) *best_clr_out = best_ray_clr;\n        return best_ray_clr >= escape_thresh;\n    }\n};\n\nstruct Node {\n    Pose pose;\n    int parent;\n    double radius;\n};\n\nint int l_end = ms.start + ms.count;\n                    double min_lf = dm;\n                    Vec3 worst_rel = rel_m;\n                    for (int li = ms.start; li < l_end; li += stride) {\n                        const auto& lf = leaves[li];\n                        Vec3 rel = R.apply(lf.x, lf.y, lf.z);\n                        Vec3 wl = rel + pose.p;\n                        double dl = eval_sdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                        if (dl < min_lf) {\n                            min_lf = dl;\n                            worst_rel = rel;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    if (min_lf < worst_d) worst_d = min_lf;\n                    if (min_lf < margin) {\n                        Vec3 wl = worst_rel + pose.p;\n                        Vec3 g = eval_grad(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                        double pen = margin - min_lf;\n                        double w = pen * pen + 1e-4;\n                        force = force + g * w;\n                        torque = torque + worst_rel.cross(g) * w;\n                        w_sum += w;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if (worst_d < -0.035 || w_sum < 1e-9) return false;\n            force = force * (1.0 / w_sum);\n            torque = torque * (1.0 / w_sum);\n            double fn = force.norm();\n            double tn = torque.norm();\n            double need = std::max(0.004, (thresh - worst_d) + 0.003);\n            double step_p = std::min(0.020, need);\n            if (fn > 1e-6) pose.p = pose.p + force * (step_p / fn);\n            if (tn > 1e-6) {\n                double step_r = std::min(0.035, need * 1.4);\n                Quat dq = quat_from_rotvec(torque * (step_r / tn));\n                pose.q = (dq * pose.q).normalized();\n            }\n        }\n        return is_valid(pose, thresh, stride);\n    }\n\n    bool valid_edge_fast(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, double thresh) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int n_steps = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.015), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.030)});\n        if (!is_valid(pose_interp(a, b, 0.5), thresh, 12)) return false;\n        for (int i = 1; i <= n_steps; ++i) {\n            if (i * 2 == n_steps) continue;\n            if (!is_valid(pose_interp(a, b, (double)i / n_steps), thresh, 12)) return false;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    bool valid_edge_exact(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, double thresh) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int n_steps = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.006), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.012)});\n        for (int i = 1; i <= n_steps; ++i) {\n            double u = (double)i / n_steps;\n            if (!is_valid(pose_interp(a, b, u), thresh, 1)) return false;\n        }\n        double t_lin = dp / 0.1, t_ang = dq / 0.1, t_max = std::max(t_lin, t_ang);\n        if (t_max > 1e-6 && std::abs(t_lin - t_ang) > 0.015) {\n            for (int i = 1; i < n_steps; ++i) {\n                double t = t_max * ((double)i / n_steps);\n                double ul = (t_lin > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_lin) : 1.0;\n                double ua = (t_ang > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_ang) : 1.0;\n                Pose pu = {a.p + (b.p - a.p) * ul, quat_slerp(a.q, b.q, ua)};\n                if (!is_valid(pu, thresh, 1)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double edge_min_clearance(const Pose& a, const Pose& b) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n dq / 0.1, t_max = std::max(t_lin, t_ang);\n        for (int i = 0; i <= n_steps; ++i) {\n            double u = (double)i / n_steps;\n            worst = std::min(worst, min_clearance(pose_interp(a, 1.0;\n                double ua = (t_ang > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_ang) : 1.0;\n                Pose pu = {a.p + (b.p - a.p) * ul, quat_slerp(a.q, b.q, ua)};\n                worst = std::min(worst, min_clearance(pu, worst, 2));\n            }\n        }\n        return worst;\n    }\n\n    // Fast ray escape check (coarse stride=12 across 96 directions, then exact stride=1 verification on winning ray!)\n    bool check_infinity_escape(const Pose& pose, double escape_thresh, Vec3* best_dir_out = nullptr, double* best_clr_out = nullptr) const {\n        const int N_DIRS = }\n            return rmin;\n        };\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < N_DIRS; ++i) {\n            double y = 1.0 - (2.0 * i + 1.0) / N_DIRS;\n            double rad = std::sqrt(std::max(0.0, 1.0 - y double dot = std::abs(a.q.w * b.q.w + a.q.x * b.q.x + a.q.y * b.q.y + a.q.z * b.q.z);\n    double dq = (dot >= 1.0) ? 0.0 : 2.828427 * std::sqrt(1.0 - dot);\n    return dp + 0.65 * dq;\n}\n\nstruct SphereNode {\n    float cx, cy, cz, r;\n    int32_t start, count;\n};\n\nstruct LeafPt {\n    float x, y, z;\n};\n\nstruct Scene {\n    uint32_t nx, ny, nz;\n    double h, inv_h;\n    Vec3 origin, 1, j * 2);\n                for (uint32_t k = 0; k < cnz; ++k) {\n                    uint32_t sk = std::min(nz - 1, k * 2);\n                    csdf[((size_t)i * cny + j) * cnz + k] =    fast_top = top;\n        for (auto& ft : fast_top) {\n            int f_start = (int)fast_leaves.size();\n            for (int mi = ft.start; mi < ft.start + ft.count; ++mi) {\n   fast_leaves.push_back(leaves[ms.start]);\n                    if (ms.count > 2) fast_leaves.push_back(leaves[ms.start + ms.count / 2]);\n                }\n            }\n            ft.start =        nx, ny, nz, cnx, cny, cnz, fast_leaves.size(), n_leaves);\n    }\n\n    inline double eval_csdf(double wx, double wy, double wz) const {\n        double fx = (wx - origin.x) * cinv_h;\n        double fy = (wy - origin.y) * cinv_h;\n        double fz = (wz - origin.z) * cinv_h;\n        if (fx >= 0.0 && fy >= 0.0 && fz >= 0.0) {\n            int ix = (int)fx, iy = (int)fy, iz = (int)fz;\n            if (ix < (int)cnx - 1 && iy < (int)cny - 1 && iz < (int)cnz - 1) {\n                double tx = fx - ix, ty = fy - iy, tz = fz - iz;\n                size_t sx = (size_t)cny * cnz, sy = (size_t)cnz;\n                const float* p = csdf.data() + (size_t)ix * sx + (size_t)iy * sy + (size_t)iz;\n                double c00 = p[0] + tx * (p[sx] - p[0]);\n                double c01 = p[1] + tx * (p[sx + 1] - p[1]);\n                double c10 = p[sy] + tx * (p[sx + sy] - p[sy]);\n                double c11 = p[sy + 1] + tx * (p[sx + sy + 1] - p[sy + 1]);\n                return (c00 + ty * (c10 - c00)) + tz * ((c01 + ty * (c11 - c01)) - (c00 + ty * (c10 - c00)));\n            }\n        }\n        double dx = std::max({0.0, a_min.x - wx, wx - a_max.x});\n        double dy = std::max({0.0, a_min.y - wy, wy - a_max.y});\n        double dz = std::max({0.0, a_min.z - wz, wz - a_max.z});\n        return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);\n    }\n\n    inline double eval_sdf(double wx, double wy, double wz) const {\n        double fx = (wx - origin.x) * inv_h;\n        double fy = (wy - origin.y) * inv_h;\n        double fz = (wz - origin.z) * inv_h;\n        if (fx >= 0.0 && fy >= 0.0 && fz >= 0.0) {\n            int ix = (int)fx, iy = (int)fy, iz = (int)fz;\n            if (ix < (int)nx - 1 && iy < (int)ny - 1 && iz < (int)nz - 1) {\n                double tx = fx - ix, ty = fy - iy, tz = fz - iz;\n                size_t sx = (size_t)ny * nz, sy = (size_t)nz;\n                const float* p = sdf.data() + (size_t)ix * sx + (size_t)iy * sy + (size_t)iz;\n                double c00 = p[0] + tx * (p[sx] - p[0]);\n                double c01 = p[1] + tx * (p[sx + 1] - p[1]);\n                double c10 = p[sy] + tx * (p[sx + sy] - p[sy]);\n                double c11 = p[sy + 1] + tx * (p[sx + sy + 1] - p[sy + 1]);\n                return (c00 + ty * (c10 - c00)) + tz * ((c01 + ty * (c11 - c01)) - (c00 + ty * (c10 - c00)));\n            }\n        }\n        double dx = std::max({0.0, a_min.x - wx, wx - a_max.x});\n        double dy = std::max({0.0, a_min.y - wy, wy - a_max.y});\n        double dz = std::max({0.0, a_min.z - wz, wz -       eval_csdf(wx + eps, wy, wz) - eval_csdf(wx - eps, wy, wz),\n            eval_csdf(wx, wy + eps, wz) - eval_csdf(wx, wy - eps, wz),\n            eval_csdf(wx, wy, wz + eps) - eval_csdf(wx, wy, wz - eps)\n        };\n        double n = g.norm();\n        return (n < 1e-9) ? Vec3{0, 0, 1} : (g * (1.0 / n));\n    }\n\n    inline bool in_workspace(const Pose& pose) const {\n        return !(pose.p.x < -0.74 || pose.p.x > 3.14 ||\n                 pose.p.y < -0.74 || fast_clearance(const Pose& pose, double cap = 0.20) const {\n        if (!in_workspace(pose)) return -1.0;\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        double best = cap;\n        for (const             double d = eval_csdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                if (d < best) best = d;\n            }\n        }\n        return best;\n    }\n\n    bool retract_fast(Pose& pose, double thresh, int max_iters = 5) const {\n        double eff = thresh + 0.0020;\n        for (int it = 0; it < max_iters; ++it) {\n            if (!in_workspace(pose)) return false;\n            Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n            double margin = eff + 0.018;\n            Vec3 force = {0, 0, 0}, torque = {0, 0, 0};\n            double w_sum = 0.0, worst_d = 1e9;\n\n            for (const auto& ft : fast_top) {\n                Vec3 wt = R.apply(ft.cx, ft.cy, ft.cz) + pose.p;\n                double dt = eval_csdf(wt.x, wt.y, wt.z);\n                if (dt - ft.r >= margin) continue;\n                if (dt < -0.05) return false;\n                int end = ft.start + ft.count;\n                double min_t = 1e9;\n                Vec3 worst_rel = {0, 0, 0};\n                for (int i = ft.start; i < end; ++i) {\n                    const auto& lf = fast_leaves[i];\n                    Vec3 rel = R.apply(lf.x, lf.y, lf.z);\n                    Vec3 wl = rel + pose.p;\n                    double dl = eval_csdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                    if (dl < min_t) { min_t = dl; worst_rel = rel; }\n                }\n                if (min_t < worst_d) worst_d = min_t;\n                if (min_t < margin) {\n                    Vec3 wl = worst_rel + pose.p;\n                    Vec3 g = eval_cgrad(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                    double pen = margin - min_t;\n                    double w = pen * pen + 1e-4;\n                    force = force + g * w;\n                    torque = torque + worst_rel.cross(g) * w;\n                    w_sum += w;\n                }\n            }\n            if (worst_d >= eff) return true;\n            if (worst_d < -0.035 || w_sum < 1e-9) return false;\n            force = force * (1.0 / w_sum);\n            torque = torque * (1.0 / w_sum);\n            double fn = force.norm(), tn = torque.norm();\n            double need = std::max(0.004, (eff - worst_d) + 0.003);\n            if (fn > 1e-6) pose.p = pose.p + force * (std::min(0.020, need) / fn);\n            if (tn > 1e-6) {\n                Quat dq = quat_from_rotvec(torque * (std::min(0.035, need * 1.4) / tn));\n                pose.q = (dq * pose.q).normalized();\n            }\n        }\n        return is_valid_fast(pose, thresh);\n    }\n\n    bool valid_edge_fast(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, double thresh) const {\n        double dp false;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Exact 91,875-leaf evaluation for Stage 2 polishing & verification!\n    bool is_valid_exact(const Pose& pose, double thresh) const {\n        if (!in_workspace(pose)) return false;\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        for (const auto& ts : top) {\n            Vec3 wt = R.apply(ts.cx, ts.cy, ts.cz) + pose.p;\n }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double min_clearance_exact(const Pose& pose, double max_cap = 0.25) const {\n        if (!in_workspace(pose)) return -1.0;\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        double best = max_cap;\n        for (const auto& ts : top) {\n            Vec3 wt = R.apply(ts.cx, ts.cy, ts.cz) + pose.p;\n            double dt = eval_sdf(wt.x, wt.y, wt.z);\n            if (dt - ts.r >= best) continue;\n            int m_end = ts.start + ts.count;\n            for (int mi = ts.start; mi < m_end; ++mi) {\n                const auto& ms = bool valid_edge_exact(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, double thresh) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int ns = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.006), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.012)});\n        for (int i = 1; i <= ns; ++i) {\n            if (!is_valid_exact(pose_interp(a, b, (double)i / ns), thresh)) return false;\n        }\n        double t_lin = dp / 0.1, t_ang = dq / 0.1, t_max = std::max(t_lin, t_ang);\n        if (t_max > 1e-6 && std::abs(t_lin - t_ang) > 0.015) {\n            for (int i = 1; i < ns; ++i) {\n                double t = t_max * ((double)i / ns);\n                double ul = (t_lin > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_lin) : 1.0;\n                double ua = (t_ang > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_ang) : }\n\n    double edge_min_clearance_exact(const Pose& a, const Pose& b) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int ns = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.006), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.012)});\n        double worst = 1.0;\n        double t_lin = dp / 0.1, t_ang = dq / 0.1, t_max = std::max(t_lin, t_ang);\n        for (int i = 0; i <= ns; ++i) {\n            double u = (double)i / ns;\n            worst = std::min(worst, min_clearance_exact(pose_interp(a, b, u), worst));\n            if (t_max > 1e-6 && std::abs(t_lin - t_ang) > 0.015) {\n                double t = t_max * u;\n                double ul = (t_lin > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_lin) : 1.0;\n                double ua = (t_ang > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_ang) : 1.0;\n                Pose pu = {a.p + (b.p - a.p) * ul, quat_slerp(a.q, b.q, ua)};\n                worst = std::min(worst, min_clearance_exact(pu, worst));\n            }\n        }\n        return worst;\n    }\n\n    bool check_infinity_escape(const Pose& pose, double escape_thresh, Vec3* best_dir_out = nullptr, double* best_clr_out = nullptr) const {\n        const int N_DIRS = 120;\n        const double golden = 3.14159265358979323846 * (3.0 - std::sqrt(5.0));\n        double best_ray_clr = -1.0;\n        Vec3 best_dir = {0, 0, 1};\n\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n s += 0.030) {\n                Vec3 shift = dir * s;\n                if ((bmin.x + shift.x > a_max.x + 0.25 && dir.x >= 0) ||\n                    (bmax.x + shift.x < a_min.x - 0.25 && dir.x <= 0) ||\n                    (bmin.y + shift.y > a_max.y + 0.25 && dir.y >= 0) ||\n                    (bmax.y + shift.y < a_min.y - 0.25 && dir.y <= 0) ||\n                    (bmin.z + shift.z > a_max.z                    const auto& lf = fast_leaves[k];\n                            Vec3 wl = R.apply(lf.x, lf.y, lf.z) + sp;\n                            double dl = eval_csdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                            if (dl < req) return -1.0;\n                            if (dl < rmin) rmin = dl;\n                        }\n                    }\n                } else {\n rmin) continue;\n                            if (dm < req) return -1.0;\n                            int l_end = ms.start + ms.count;\n                            for (int li = ms.start; li < l_end;   }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            return rmin;\n        };\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < N_DIRS; ++i) {\n            double y = 1.0 - (2.0 * i + 1.0) / double fy = (wy - origin.y) * inv_h;\n        double fz = (wz - origin.z) * inv_h;\n        if (fx >= 0.0 && fy >= 0.0 && fz >= 0.0) {\n            int ix = (int)fx, iy = (int)fy, iz = (int)fz;\n            if (ix < (int)nx - 1 && iy < (int)ny - 1 && iz < (int)nz - 1) {\n                double tx = fx - ix, ty = fy - iy, tz = fz - iz;\n                size_t sx = (size_t)ny * nz, sy = (size_t)nz;\n                const float* p = sdf.data() + (size_t)ix * sx + (size_t)iy * sy + (size_t)iz;\n                double c00 = p[0] + tx * (p[sx] - p[0]);\n                double c01 = p[1] + tx * (p[sx + 1] - p[1]);\n                double c10 = p[sy] + tx * (p[sx + sy] - p[sy]);\n                double c11 = p[sy + 1] + tx * (p[sx + sy + 1] - p[sy + 1]);\n                return (c00 + ty * (c10 - c00)) + tz * ((c01 + ty * (c11 - c01)) - (c00 + ty * (c10 - c00)));\n            }\n        }\n        double dx = std::max({0.0, a_min.x - wx, wx - a_max.x});\n        double dy = std::max({0.0, a_min.y - wy, wy - a_max.y});\n        double dz = std::max({0.0, a_min.z - wz, wz - a_max.z});\n        return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);\n    }\n\n    inline Vec3 eval_cgrad(double wx, double wy, double wz) const {\n        double eps = 0.010;\n        Vec3 g = {\n            eval_csdf(wx + eps, wy, wz) - eval_csdf(wx - eps, wy, wz),\n            eval_csdf(wx, wy + eps, wz) - eval_csdf(wx, wy - eps, wz),\n            eval_csdf(wx, wy, wz + eps) - eval_csdf(wx, wy, wz - eps)\n        };\n        double n = g.norm();\n        return (n < 1e-9) ? Vec3{0, 0, 1} : (g * (1.0 / n));\n    }\n\n    inline bool in_workspace(const Pose& pose) const {\n        return !(pose.p.x < -0.74 || pose.p.x > 3.14 ||\n                 pose.p.y < -0.74 || pose.p.y > 3.14 ||\n                 pose.p.z < -0.74 || pose.p.z > 3.14);\n    }\n\n    inline bool is_valid_fast(const Pose& pose, double thresh) const {\n        if (!in_workspace(pose)) return false;\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        double eff = thresh + 0.0020;\n        for (const auto& ft : fast_top) {\n            Vec3 wt = R.apply(ft.cx, ft.cy, ft.cz) + pose.p;\n            double dt = eval_csdf(wt.x, wt.y, wt.z);\n            if (dt - ft.r >= eff) continue;\n            if (dt < -0.05) return false;\n            int end = ft.start + ft.count;\n            for (int i = ft.start; i < end; ++i) {\n                const auto& lf = fast_leaves[i];\n                Vec3 wl = R.apply(lf.x, lf.y, lf.z) + pose.p;\n                if (eval_csdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z) < eff) return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    bool retract_fast(Pose& pose, double thresh, int max_iters = 5) const {\n        double eff = thresh + 0.0020;\n        for (int it = 0; it < max_iters; ++it) {\n            if (!in_workspace(pose)) return false;\n            Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n            double margin = eff + 0.018;\n            Vec3 force = {0, 0, 0}, torque = {0, 0, 0};\n            double w_sum = 0.0, worst_d = 1e9;\n\n            for (const auto& ft : fast_top) {\n                Vec3 wt = R.apply(ft.cx, ft.cy, ft.cz) + pose.p;\n                double dt = eval_csdf(wt.x, wt.y, wt.z);\n                if (dt - ft.r >= margin) continue;\n                if (dt < -0.05) return false;\n                int end = ft.start + ft.count;\n                double min_t = 1e9;\n                Vec3 worst_rel = {0, 0, 0};\n                for (int i = ft.start; i < end; ++i) {\n                    const auto& lf = fast_leaves[i];\n                    Vec3 rel = R.apply(lf.x, lf.y, lf.z);\n                    Vec3 wl = rel + pose.p;\n                    double dl = eval_csdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                    if (dl < -0.04) return false;\n                    if (dl < min_t) { min_t = dl; worst_rel = rel; }\n                }\n                if (min_t < worst_d) worst_d = min_t;\n                if (min_t < margin) {\n                    Vec3 wl = worst_rel + pose.p;\n                    Vec3 g = eval_cgrad(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                    double pen = margin - min_t;\n                    double w = pen * pen + 1e-4;\n                    force = force + g * w;\n                    torque = torque + worst_rel.cross(g) * w;\n                    w_sum += w;\n                }\n            }\n            if (worst_d >= eff) return true;\n            if (worst_d < -0.035 || w_sum < 1e-9) return false;\n            force = force * (1.0 / w_sum);\n            torque = torque * (1.0 / w_sum);\n            double fn = force.norm(), tn = torque.norm();\n            double need = std::max(0.004, (eff - worst_d) + 0.003);\n            if (fn > 1e-6) pose.p = pose.p + force * (std::min(0.020, need) / fn);\n            if (tn > 1e-6) {\n                Quat dq = quat_from_rotvec(torque * (std::min(0.035, need * 1.4) / tn));\n                pose.q = (dq * pose.q).normalized();\n            }\n        }\n        return is_valid_fast(pose, thresh);\n    }\n\n    bool valid_edge_fast(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, double thresh) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int ns = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.016), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.032)});\n        if (!is_valid_fast(pose_interp(a, b, 0.5), thresh)) return false;\n        for (int i = 1; i <= ns; ++i) {\n            if (i * 2 == ns) continue;\n            if (!is_valid_fast(pose_interp(a, b, (double)i / ns), thresh)) return false;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    bool is_valid_exact(const Pose& pose, double thresh) const {\n        if (!in_workspace(pose)) return false;\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        for (const auto& ts : top) {\n            Vec3 wt = R.apply(ts.cx, ts.cy, ts.cz) + pose.p;\n            double dt = eval_sdf(wt.x, wt.y, wt.z);\n            if (dt - ts.r >= thresh) continue;\n            int m_end = ts.start + ts.count;\n            for (int mi = ts.start; mi < m_end; ++mi) {\n                const auto& ms = mid[mi];\n                Vec3 wm = R.apply(ms.cx, ms.cy, ms.cz) + pose.p;\n                double dm = eval_sdf(wm.x, wm.y, wm.z);\n                if (dm - ms.r >= thresh) continue;\n                if (dm < thresh) return false;\n                int l_end = ms.start + ms.count;\n                for (int li = ms.start; li < l_end; ++li) {\n                    const auto& lf = leaves[li];\n                    Vec3 wl = R.apply(lf.x, lf.y, lf.z) + pose.p;\n                    if (eval_sdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z) < thresh) return false;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double min_clearance_exact(const Pose& pose, double max_cap = 0.25) const {\n        if (!in_workspace(pose)) return -1.0;\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        double best = max_cap;\n        for (const auto& ts : top) {\n            Vec3 wt = R.apply(ts.cx, ts.cy, ts.cz) + pose.p;\n            double dt = eval_sdf(wt.x, wt.y, wt.z);\n            if (dt - ts.r >= best) continue;\n            int m_end = ts.start + ts.count;\n            for (int mi = ts.start; mi < m_end; ++mi) {\n                const auto& ms = mid[mi];\n                Vec3 wm = R.apply(ms.cx, ms.cy, ms.cz) + pose.p;\n                double dm = eval_sdf(wm.x, wm.y, wm.z);\n                if (dm - ms.r >= best) continue;\n                int l_end = ms.start + ms.count;\n                for (int li = ms.start; li < l_end; ++li) {\n                    const auto& lf = leaves[li];\n                    Vec3 wl = R.apply(lf.x, lf.y, lf.z) + pose.p;\n                    double dl = eval_sdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                    if (dl < best) best = dl;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return best;\n    }\n\n    bool valid_edge_exact(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, double thresh) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int ns = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.006), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.012)});\n        for (int i = 1; i <= ns; ++i) {\n            if (!is_valid_exact(pose_interp(a, b, (double)i / ns), thresh)) return false;\n        }\n        double t_lin = dp / 0.1, t_ang = dq / 0.1, t_max = std::max(t_lin, t_ang);\n        if (t_max > 1e-6 && std::abs(t_lin - t_ang) > 0.015) {\n            for (int i = 1; i < ns; ++i) {\n                double t = t_max * ((double)i / ns);\n                double ul = (t_lin > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_lin) : 1.0;\n                double ua = (t_ang > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_ang) : 1.0;\n                Pose pu = {a.p + (b.p - a.p) * ul, quat_slerp(a.q, b.q, ua)};\n                if (!is_valid_exact(pu, thresh)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double edge_min_clearance_exact(const Pose& a, const Pose& b) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int ns = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.006), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.012)});\n        double worst = 1.0;\n        double t_lin = dp / 0.1, t_ang = dq / 0.1, t_max = std::max(t_lin, t_ang);\n        for (int i = 0; i < N_DIRS; ++i) {\n            double y = 1.0 - (2.0 * i + 1.0) / N_DIRS;\n            double rad = std::sqrt(std::max(0.0, 1.0 - y * y));\n            double phi = golden * i;\n            Vec3 dir = {std::cos(phi) * rad, y, std::sin(phi) * rad};\n            double cc = eval_ray(dir, false, std::max(escape_thresh + 0.002, best_ray_clr));\n            if (cc >= escape_thresh) {\n                double ce = eval_ray(dir, true, escape_thresh);\n                if (ce > best_ray_clr) { best_ray_clr = ce; }\n};\n\nstruct RRTNode {\n    float px, py, pz, qw, qx, qy, qz;\n    int parent;\n    int root_id;\n    float dd_rad;\n\n    Pose to_pose() const { return {{px, py, pz}, {qw, qx, qy, qz}}; }\n -b.y, -b.z}; d = -d; }\n    if (d > 0.9995) {\n        return Quat{a.w + t * (b.w - a.w), a.x + t * (b.x - a.x),\n                    a.y + t * (b.y - a.y), a.z + t * (b.z - a.z)}.normalized();\n    }\n    double theta = std::acos(d), st = std::sin(theta);\n    double wa = std::sin((1.0 - t) * theta) / st, wb = std::sin(t * theta) / st;\n    return Quat{wa * a.w + wb * b.w, wa * a.x + wb * b.x,\n                wa * a.y + wb * b.y, wa * a.z + wb * b.z}.normalized();\n}\n\nQuat quat_from_rotvec(const Vec3& rv) {\n    double ang = rv.norm();\n    if (ang < 1e-10) return Quat{1.0, 0.5 * rv.x, 0.5 * rv.y, 0.5 * rv.z}.normalized();\n    double s = std::sin(0.5 * ang) / ang;\n    return Quat{std::cos(0.5 * ang), rv.x * s, rv.y * s, rv.z * s}.normalized();\n}\n\nstruct Pose {\n    Vec3 p;\n    Quat q;\n};\n\nPose pose_interp(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, double t) {\n    return {a.p + (b.p - a.p) * t, quat_slerp(a.q, b.q, t)};\n}\n\nstruct SphereNode {\n    float cx, cy, cz, r;\n    int32_t start, count;\n};\n\nstruct LeafPt {\n    float x, y, z;\n};\n\nstruct Scene {\n    uint32_t nx, ny, nz;\n    double h, inv_h;\n    Vec3 origin, a_min, a_max;\n    std::vector<float> sdf;\n\n    uint32_t cnx, cny, cnz;\n    double ch, cinv_h;\n    std::vector<float> csdf;\n\n    std::vector<SphereNode> top, mid, fast_top;\n    std::vector<LeafPt> leaves, fast_leaves;\n\n    Vec3 M_A, M_B_loc;\n    std::vector<Vec3> loop_a_mid, loop_a_tan;\n    std::vector<Vec3> loop_b_mid_loc, loop_b_tan_loc;\n\n    void load(const char* path, const char* loop_path) {\n        FILE* f = std::fopen(path, \"rb\");\n        if (!f) { std::perror(\"fopen\"); std::exit(1); }\n        uint32_t magic;\n        if (std::fread(&magic, 4, 1, f) != 1 || magic != 0x414C5048) std::exit(1);\n        if (std::fread(&nx, 4, 1, f) != 1) std::exit(1);\n        if (std::fread(&ny, 4, 1, f) != 1) std::exit(1);\n        if (std::fread(&nz, 4, 1, f) != 1) std::exit(1);\n        double hdr[10];\n        if (std::fread(hdr, sizeof(double), 10, f) != 10) std::exit(1);\n        h = hdr[0]; inv_h = 1.0 / h;\n        origin = {hdr[1], hdr[2], hdr[3]};\n        a_min = {hdr[4], hdr[5], hdr[6]};\n        a_max = {hdr[7], hdr[8], hdr[9]};\n        uint32_t n_top, n_mid, n_leaves;\n        if (std::fread(&n_top, 4, 1, f) != 1) std::exit(1);\n        if (std::fread(&n_mid, 4, 1, f) != 1) std::exit(1);\n        if (std::fread(&n_leaves, 4, 1, f) != 1) std::exit(1);\n        size_t n_vox = (size_t)nx * ny * nz;\n        sdf.resize(n_vox);\n        if (std::fread(sdf.data(), sizeof(float), n_vox, f) != n_vox) std::exit(1);\n        top.resize(n_top);\n        if (std::fread(top.data(), sizeof(SphereNode), n_top, f) != n_top) std::exit(1);\n        mid.resize(n_mid);\n        if (std::fread(mid.data(), sizeof(SphereNode), n_mid, f) != n_mid) std::exit(1);\n        leaves.resize(n_leaves);\n        if (std::fread(leaves.data(), sizeof(LeafPt), n_leaves, f) != n_leaves) std::exit(1);\n        std::fclose(f);\n\n        cnx = (nx + 1) / 2; cny = (ny + 1) / 2; cnz = (nz + 1) / 2;\n        ch = h * 2.0; cinv_h = 1.0 / ch;\n        csdf.resize((size_t)cnx * cny * cnz);\n        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cnx; ++i) {\n            uint32_t si = std::min(nx - 1, i * 2);\n            for (uint32_t j = 0; j < cny; ++j) {\n                uint32_t sj = std::min(ny - 1, j * 2);\n                for (uint32_t k = 0; k < cnz; ++k) {\n                    uint32_t sk = std::min(nz - 1, k * 2);\n                    csdf[((size_t)i * cny + j) * cnz + k] = sdf[((size_t)si * ny * nz + (size_t)sj * nz + sk)];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        fast_top = top;\n        for (auto& ft : fast_top) {\n            int f_start = (int)fast_leaves.size();\n            for (int mi = ft.start; mi < ft.start + ft.count; ++mi) {\n                const auto& ms = mid[mi];\n                fast_leaves.push_back({ms.cx, ms.cy, ms.cz});\n                if (ms.count > 0) fast_leaves.push_back(leaves[ms.start]);\n                if (ms.count > 2) fast_leaves.push_back(leaves[ms.start + ms.count / 2]);\n            }\n            ft.start = f_start;\n            ft.count = (int)fast_leaves.size() - f_start;\n        }\n\n        FILE* lf = std::fopen(loop_path, \"r\");\n        if (!lf) { std::perror(\"fopen loops\"); std::exit(1); }\n        int m_pts = 0;\n        if (std::fscanf(lf, \"%d\", &m_pts) != 1) std::exit(1);\n        std::fscanf(lf, \"%lf %lf %lf\", &M_A.x, &M_A.y, &M_A.z);\n        std::fscanf(lf, \"%lf %lf %lf\", &M_B_loc.x, &M_B_loc.y, &M_B_loc.z);\n        std::vector<Vec3> pa(m_pts), pb(m_pts);\n        for (int i = 0; i < m_pts; ++i) std::fscanf(lf, \"%lf %lf %lf\", &pa[i].x, &pa[i].y, &pa[i].z);\n        for (int i = 0; i < m_pts; ++i) std::fscanf(lf, \"%lf %lf %lf\", &pb[i].x, &pb[i].y, &pb[i].z);\n        std::fclose(lf);\n        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < m_pts; ++i) {\n            loop_a_mid.push_back((pa[i] + pa[i + 1]) * 0.5);\n            loop_a_tan.push_back(pa[i + 1] - pa[i]);\n            loop_b_mid_loc.push_back((pb[i] + pb[i + 1]) * 0.5);\n            loop_b_tan_loc.push_back(pb[i + 1] - pb[i]);\n        }\n        std::printf(\"Loaded Scene: %ux%ux%u SDF, %zu fast_leaves, %zu closed-loop segs\\n\",\n                    nx, ny, nz, fast_leaves.size(), loop_a_mid.size());\n    }\n\n    inline Vec3 world_MB(const Pose& pose) const {\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        return R.apply(M_B_loc.x, M_B_loc.y, M_B_loc.z) + pose.p;\n    }\n\n    inline double throat_dist(const Pose& pose) const {\n        return (world_MB(pose) - M_A).norm();\n    }\n\n    inline double abs_closed_lk(const Pose& pose) const {\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        size_t M = loop_a_mid.size();\n        Vec3 bm[32], bt[32];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < M; ++j) {\n            bm[j] = R.apply(loop_b_mid_loc[j].x, loop_b_mid_loc[j].y, loop_b_mid_loc[j].z) + pose.p;\n            bt[j] = R.apply(loop_b_tan_loc[j].x, loop_b_tan_loc[j].y, loop_b_tan_loc[j].z);\n        }\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < M; ++i) {\n            const Vec3& am = loop_a_mid[i];\n            const Vec3& at = loop_a_tan[i];\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < M; ++j) {\n                double rx = am.x - bm[j].x, ry = am.y - bm[j].y, rz = am.z - bm[j].z;\n                double d2 = rx * rx + ry * ry + rz * rz;\n                double inv_d3 = 1.0 / (d2 * std::sqrt(d2) + 1e-6);\n                double cx = at.y * bt[j].z - at.z * bt[j].y;\n                double cy = at.z * bt[j].x - at.x * bt[j].z;\n                double cz = at.x * bt[j].y - at.y * bt[j].x;\n                sum += (cx * rx + cy * ry + cz * rz) * inv_d3;\n            }\n        }\n        return std::abs(sum) * (1.0 / (4.0 * 3.14159265358979323846));\n    }\n\n    inline double eval_csdf(double wx, double wy, double wz) const {\n        double fx = (wx - origin.x) * cinv_h;\n        double fy = (wy - origin.y) * cinv_h;\n        double fz = (wz - origin.z) * cinv_h;\n        if (fx >= 0.0 && fy >= 0.0 && fz >= 0.0) {\n            int ix = (int)fx, iy = (int)fy, iz = (int)fz;\n            if (ix < (int)cnx - 1 && iy < (int)cny - 1 && iz < (int)cnz - 1) {\n                double tx = fx - ix, ty = fy - iy, tz = fz - iz;\n                size_t sx = (size_t)cny * cnz, sy = (size_t)cnz;\n                const float* p = csdf.data() + (size_t)ix * sx + (size_t)iy * sy + (size_t)iz;\n                double c00 = p[0] + tx * (p[sx] - p[0]);\n                double c01 = p[1] + tx * (p[sx + 1] - p[1]);\n                double c10 = p[sy] + tx * (p[sx + sy] - p[sy]);\n                double c11 = p[sy + 1] + tx * (p[sx + sy + 1] - p[sy + 1]);\n                return (c00 + ty * (c10 - c00)) + tz * ((c01 + ty * (c11 - c01)) - (c00 + ty * (c10 - c00)));\n            }\n        }\n        double dx = std::max({0.0, a_min.x - wx, wx - a_max.x});\n        double dy = std::max({0.0, a_min.y - wy, wy - a_max.y});\n        double dz = std::max({0.0, a_min.z - wz, wz - a_max.z});\n        return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);\n    }\n\n    inline double eval_sdf(double wx, double wy, double wz) const {\n        double fx = (wx - origin.x) * inv_h;\n        double fy = (wy - origin.y) * inv_h;\n        double fz = (wz - origin.z) * inv_h;\n        if (fx >= 0.0 && fy >= 0.0 && fz >= 0.0) {\n            int ix = (int)fx, iy = (int)fy, iz = (int)fz;\n            if (ix < (int)nx - 1 && iy < (int)ny - 1 && iz < (int)nz - 1) {\n                double tx = fx - ix, ty = fy - iy, tz = fz - iz;\n                size_t sx = (size_t)ny * nz, sy = (size_t)nz;\n                const float* p = sdf.data() + (size_t)ix * sx + (size_t)iy * sy + (size_t)iz;\n                double c00 = p[0] + tx * (p[sx] - p[0]);\n                double c01 = p[1] + tx * (p[sx + 1] - p[1]);\n                double c10 = p[sy] + tx * (p[sx + sy] - p[sy]);\n                double c11 = p[sy + 1] + tx * (p[sx + sy + 1] - p[sy + 1]);\n                return (c00 + ty * (c10 - c00)) + tz * ((c01 + ty * (c11 - c01)) - (c00 + ty * (c10 - c00)));\n            }\n        }\n        double dx = std::max({0.0, a_min.x - wx, wx - a_max.x});\n        double dy = std::max({0.0, a_min.y - wy, wy - a_max.y});\n        double dz = std::max({0.0, a_min.z - wz, wz - a_max.z});\n        return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);\n    }\n\n    inline Vec3 eval_cgrad(double wx, double wy, double wz) const {\n        double eps = 0.010;\n        Vec3 g = {\n            eval_csdf(wx + eps, wy, wz) - eval_csdf(wx - eps, wy, wz),\n            eval_csdf(wx, wy + eps, wz) - eval_csdf(wx, wy - eps, wz),\n            eval_csdf(wx, wy, wz + eps) - eval_csdf(wx, wy, wz - eps)\n        };\n        double n = g.norm();\n        return (n < 1e-9) ? Vec3{0, 0, 1} : (g * (1.0 / n));\n    }\n\n    inline bool in_workspace(const Pose& pose) const {\n        return !(pose.p.x < -0.74 || pose.p.x > 3.14 ||\n                 pose.p.y < -0.74 || pose.p.y > 3.14 ||\n                 pose.p.z < -0.74 || pose.p.z > 3.14);\n    }\n\n    inline bool is_valid_fast(const Pose& pose, double thresh) const {\n        if (!in_workspace(pose)) return false;\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        double eff = thresh + 0.0015;\n        for (const auto& ft : fast_top) {\n            Vec3 wt = R.apply(ft.cx, ft.cy, ft.cz) + pose.p;\n            double dt = eval_csdf(wt.x, wt.y, wt.z);\n            if (dt - ft.r >= eff) continue;\n            if (dt < -0.05) return false;\n            int end = ft.start + ft.count;\n            for (int i = ft.start; i < end; ++i) {\n                const auto& lf = fast_leaves[i];\n                Vec3 wl = R.apply(lf.x, lf.y, lf.z) + pose.p;\n                if (eval_csdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z) < eff) return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    bool retract_fast(Pose& pose, double thresh, int max_iters = 5) const {\n        double eff = thresh + 0.0015;\n        for (int it = 0; it < max_iters; ++it) {\n            if (!in_workspace(pose)) return false;\n            Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n            double margin = eff + 0.018;\n            Vec3 force = {0, 0, 0}, torque = {0, 0, 0};\n            double w_sum = 0.0, worst_d = 1e9;\n\n            for (const auto& ft : fast_top) {\n                Vec3 wt = R.apply(ft.cx, ft.cy, ft.cz) + pose.p;\n                double dt = eval_csdf(wt.x, wt.y, wt.z);\n                if (dt - ft.r >= margin) continue;\n                if (dt < -0.05) return false;\n                int end = ft.start + ft.count;\n                double min_t = 1e9;\n                Vec3 worst_rel = {0, 0, 0};\n                for (int i = ft.start; i < end; ++i) {\n                    const auto& lf = fast_leaves[i];\n                    Vec3 rel = R.apply(lf.x, lf.y, lf.z);\n                    Vec3 wl = rel + pose.p;\n                    double dl = eval_csdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                    if (dl < -0.04) return false;\n                    if (dl < min_t) { min_t = dl; worst_rel = rel; }\n                }\n                if (min_t < worst_d) worst_d = min_t;\n                if (min_t < margin) {\n                    Vec3 wl = worst_rel + pose.p;\n                    Vec3 g = eval_cgrad(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                    double pen = margin - min_t;\n                    double w = pen * pen + 1e-4;\n                    force = force + g * w;\n                    torque = torque + worst_rel.cross(g) * w;\n                    w_sum += w;\n                }\n            }\n            if (worst_d >= eff) return true;\n            if (worst_d < -0.035 || w_sum < 1e-9) return false;\n            force = force * (1.0 / w_sum);\n            torque = torque * (1.0 / w_sum);\n            double fn = force.norm(), tn = torque.norm();\n            double need = std::max(0.004, (eff - worst_d) + 0.003);\n            if (fn > 1e-6) pose.p = pose.p + force * (std::min(0.020, need) / fn);\n            if (tn > 1e-6) {\n                Quat dq = quat_from_rotvec(torque * (std::min(0.035, need * 1.4) / tn));\n                pose.q = (dq * pose.q).normalized();\n            }\n        }\n        return is_valid_fast(pose, thresh);\n    }\n\n    bool valid_edge_fast(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, double thresh) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int ns = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.015), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.030)});\n        if (!is_valid_fast(pose_interp(a, b, 0.5), thresh)) return false;\n        for (int i = 1; i <= ns; ++i) {\n            if (i * 2 == ns) continue;\n            if (!is_valid_fast(pose_interp(a, b, (double)i / ns), thresh)) return false;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    bool is_valid_exact(const Pose& pose, double thresh) const {\n        if (!in_workspace(pose)) return false;\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        for (const auto& ts : top) {\n            Vec3 wt = R.apply(ts.cx, ts.cy, ts.cz) + pose.p;\n            double dt = eval_sdf(wt.x, wt.y, wt.z);\n            if (dt - ts.r >= thresh) continue;\n            int m_end = ts.start + ts.count;\n            for (int mi = ts.start; mi < m_end; ++mi) {\n                const auto& ms = mid[mi];\n                Vec3 wm = R.apply(ms.cx, ms.cy, ms.cz) + pose.p;\n                double dm = eval_sdf(wm.x, wm.y, wm.z);\n                if (dm - ms.r >= thresh) continue;\n                if (dm < thresh) return false;\n                int l_end = ms.start + ms.count;\n                for (int li = ms.start; li < l_end; ++li) {\n                    const auto& lf = leaves[li];\n                    Vec3 wl = R.apply(lf.x, lf.y, lf.z) + pose.p;\n                    if (eval_sdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z) < thresh) return false;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double min_clearance_exact(const Pose& pose, double max_cap = 0.25) const {\n        if (!in_workspace(pose)) return -1.0;\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        double best = max_cap;\n        for (const auto& ts : top) {\n            Vec3 wt = R.apply(ts.cx, ts.cy, ts.cz) + pose.p;\n            double dt = eval_sdf(wt.x, wt.y, wt.z);\n            if (dt - ts.r >= best) continue;\n            int m_end = ts.start + ts.count;\n            for (int mi = ts.start; mi < m_end; ++mi) {\n                const auto& ms = mid[mi];\n                Vec3 wm = R.apply(ms.cx, ms.cy, ms.cz) + pose.p;\n                double dm = eval_sdf(wm.x, wm.y, wm.z);\n                if (dm - ms.r >= best) continue;\n                int l_end = ms.start + ms.count;\n                for (int li = ms.start; li < l_end; ++li) {\n                    const auto& lf = leaves[li];\n                    Vec3 wl = R.apply(lf.x, lf.y, lf.z) + pose.p;\n                    double dl = eval_sdf(wl.x, wl.y, wl.z);\n                    if (dl < best) best = dl;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return best;\n    }\n\n    bool valid_edge_exact(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, double thresh) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int ns = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.006), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.012)});\n        for (int i = 1; i <= ns; ++i) {\n            if (!is_valid_exact(pose_interp(a, b, (double)i / ns), thresh)) return false;\n        }\n        double t_lin = dp / 0.1, t_ang = dq / 0.1, t_max = std::max(t_lin, t_ang);\n        if (t_max > 1e-6 && std::abs(t_lin - t_ang) > 0.015) {\n            for (int i = 1; i < ns; ++i) {\n                double t = t_max * ((double)i / ns);\n                double ul = (t_lin > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_lin) : 1.0;\n                double ua = (t_ang > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_ang) : 1.0;\n                Pose pu = {a.p + (b.p - a.p) * ul, quat_slerp(a.q, b.q, ua)};\n                if (!is_valid_exact(pu, thresh)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double edge_min_clearance_exact(const Pose& a, const Pose& b) const {\n        double dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n        double dq = quat_angle(a.q, b.q);\n        int ns = std::max({2, (int)std::ceil(dp / 0.006), (int)std::ceil(dq / 0.012)});\n        double worst = 1.0;\n        double t_lin = dp / 0.1, t_ang = dq / 0.1, t_max = std::max(t_lin, t_ang);\n        for (int i = 0; i <= ns; ++i) {\n            double u = (double)i / ns;\n            worst = std::min(worst, min_clearance_exact(pose_interp(a, b, u), worst));\n            if (t_max > 1e-6 && std::abs(t_lin - t_ang) > 0.015) {\n                double t = t_max * u;\n                double ul = (t_lin > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_lin) : 1.0;\n                double ua = (t_ang > 1e-8) ? std::min(1.0, t / t_ang) : 1.0;\n                Pose pu = {a.p + (b.p - a.p) * ul, quat_slerp(a.q, b.q, ua)};\n                worst = std::min(worst, min_clearance_exact(pu, worst));\n            }\n        }\n        return worst;\n    }\n\n    bool check_infinity_escape(const Pose& pose, double escape_thresh, Vec3* best_dir_out = nullptr, double* best_clr_out = nullptr) const {\n        const int N_DIRS = 120;\n        const double golden = 3.14159265358979323846 * (3.0 - std::sqrt(5.0));\n        double best_ray_clr = -1.0;\n        Vec3 best_dir = {0, 0, 1};\n\n        Mat3 R = Mat3::from_quat(pose.q);\n        Vec3 bmin = {1e9, 1e9, 1e9}, bmax = {-1e9, -1e9, -1e9};\n        for (const auto& ts : top) {\n            Vec3 w = R.apply(ts.cx, ts.cy, ts.cz) + pose.p;\n            bmin.x = std::min(bmin.x, w.x - ts.r);
